run_count_per_shard: run substring matching on text shards and count metadata matches for a shard range
run_global_count: run global aggregation of per-shard match counts and compute per-language sampling probabilities
run_curate: run curation of image-text pairs using probability-based sampling across a shard range
use_p_to_t: use p_to_t to convert a tail portion into a count threshold from entry counts
use_count_to_prob: use count_to_prob to convert raw entry counts into sampling probabilities using a threshold
